messages.subject: mirtCAT customization
parts:
Hi Phil,

I am looking for ways to integrate mirtCAT into another application (using shiny as well) and would like to if it is possible to:

use the CAT engine but write the UI myself? So, essentially, I will call a R function to initialise the engine, sort of like the preamble function(), then for each item response, I update the engine and the engine tells me the next item or complete, etc, essentially treating the engine as a state machine.

To achieve the above, I am wondering besides forking the code base, with the existing code, am I able to do that? 

Thanks and I appreciate any suggestion. 

Regards,
Zhao

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT customization
parts:
Yes, this is possible, but it does require quite a bit of work on the user's end. Functions like findNextCATitem() and computeCriteria() are such examples of the manual CAT calls that you would need to interact with in order for your GUI to work alongside the R computations. 

Phil
